claim_boundary: A registry entry is not a download authorization, benchmark result, or evidence that one task transfers to another.

cohort_definitions.prompted_typing: A participant types a prompted or memorized sentence; keystrokes and sentence targets may support event and sequence metrics.
cohort_definitions.inner_or_imagined_speech: A participant internally rehearses or imagines a small prompted speech unit; this is not open-vocabulary text generation.
cohort_definitions.natural_reading: A participant reads displayed text; the displayed text is stimulus context, not text produced from neural activity.
cohort_definitions.p300: A stimulus-locked oddball response classification task.

registry_gaps: No second public EEG dataset with the same prompted-sentence typing and keystroke-label contract as SpanishBCBL was verified in this pass.
Unknown byte counts remain null until an official file manifest can be inspected without downloading signal payloads.
P300, SSVEP, motor imagery, reading, and imagined speech are qualification cohorts and must not be merged with prompted typing.

records.task: Read, wait, then type a briefly memorized Spanish sentence without on-screen feedback.

sessions.detail: Session count varies; each session used 128 unique sentences. Five people participated in both EEG and MEG, and some MEG subject IDs map to the same person.

records.splits: No benchmark split is supplied as a safe default; bind a frozen subject/session/trial protocol before fitting.

acquisition.geometry: MEG geometry is carried in FIF; EEG geometry availability must be validated per BrainVision bundle.
acquisition.reference_unavailable_reason: The canonical dataset card does not publish the EEG reference scheme.

formats.labels: Sentence stimuli, performed keystrokes, and timing are available in behavioral logs after alignment validation.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: Fresh complete S20 session-2 block-2 BrainVision triplet plus matching MAT log.

leakage_risks: Repeated MEG subject IDs can put the same person in multiple nominal subject groups.
Event-level random splits leak sentence and recording context; split by trial or stricter group.
Preprocessing statistics must be fit on train rows only.
S21 session 2 and the local S7 EEG evaluation are consumed and forbidden for tuning or fresh evaluation.
known_limitations: Healthy skilled typists performing prompted memorized typing do not establish arbitrary-thought decoding.
MEG and EEG are separate evidence cohorts.
The public release is noncommercial under CC-BY-NC-4.0.
records.proof_posture: Task-compatible source with validated local adapters; existing neural comparisons are negative.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: It matches the existing typing and trigger-alignment contracts, and the exact 96,090,264-byte S20 bundle is the smallest fresh complete EEG block in the pinned manifest.

records.license: CC0-1.0 for the OpenNeuro data; article is CC-BY-4.0
records.task: Four prompted commands under inner-speech, pronounced-speech, and visualized conditions.

sessions.detail: Thirty BIDS recordings in the canonical dataset.

records.splits: No frozen NeuroDecodeKit split; participant and condition boundaries must be preserved.

acquisition.geometry: BioSemi 128-channel cap layout; per-record geometry must be verified from BIDS sidecars.
acquisition.reference_scheme: BioSemi ActiveTwo CMS/DRL acquisition; analysis reference must be declared.

formats.labels: Condition and one of four command classes are available.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One complete participant across all three conditions, subject to a metadata dry run.

leakage_risks: Pronounced-speech EMG and EOG can dominate classification if channels or conditions are mixed.
Trial-wise random splits can leak participant and session signatures.
The four prompted classes do not support open-vocabulary sequence claims.
known_limitations: Small command classification is not sentence decoding.
Inner, pronounced, and visualized conditions require separate reports and ablations.
records.proof_posture: Credible imagined-speech classification cohort; not comparable to prompted typing CER/WER.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Useful for BIDS/BDF and multimodal leakage qualification, but less task-compatible than SpanishBCBL EEG.

records.task: Natural English sentence reading in two normal-reading tasks and one relation-search task.

sessions.detail: Three reading paradigms, 1,107 sentences, 21,629 words, and 154,173 fixations.

records.splits: No frozen NeuroDecodeKit split; subject and sentence identity must be grouped.

acquisition.geometry: 128-channel Geodesic HydroCel net; source eye coordinates and fixation assignments are available.

formats.labels: Displayed sentence/word context, reading task, and eye-fixation features.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One subject and one complete reading task, subject to OSF metadata inspection.

leakage_risks: Eye tracking identifies attended words and can dominate combined models.
Displayed text is stimulus input, not text produced by the participant.
Sentence overlap or task labels can leak across random splits.
known_limitations: Reading evidence cannot be reported as language production or brain-to-text.
Brain-only, eye-only, and combined ablations are mandatory.
records.proof_posture: Strong EEG-plus-eye reading and multimodal-ablation cohort; not a typing or generation benchmark.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Valuable for multimodal intake and leakage controls, but it cannot answer the prompted-typing question.

records.license: Academic non-profit use only; citation required
records.task: Imagine and then vocalize seven phonemic/syllabic prompts and four words.

sessions.detail: One 30-40 minute prompted session per participant.

records.splits: No frozen NeuroDecodeKit split; leave-participant-out is required for unseen-person claims.

acquisition.reference_unavailable_reason: The public dataset page does not state the acquisition reference.

formats.labels: Prompt identities and imagined/overt phases are available; audio and face features accompany overt speech.

leakage_risks: Audio, facial motion, EOG, and muscle activity can reveal the prompt.
Imagined and overt phases must not be mixed without modality ablations.
Participant archives are compressed and must never be extracted without traversal and byte caps.
known_limitations: Eleven prompted units do not support sentence or open-vocabulary claims.
License is narrower than a standard open-data license.
records.proof_posture: Imagined-phonology classification and multimodal leakage cohort only.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Large archives, restrictive terms, CNT intake, and strong peripheral leakage make it a later qualification target.

records.task: Visual P300 oddball classification in a 36-symbol Brain Invaders grid.

sessions.detail: One run per session with target and non-target flashes.

records.splits: MOABB within-session evaluation is available; freeze the exact MOABB paradigm and version before use.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One subject across all three sessions for session-aware P300 qualification.

leakage_risks: Flash-level random splits leak session and symbol context.
Class imbalance can make raw accuracy misleading.
A P300 symbol-selection task is not natural typing.
known_limitations: Use balanced metrics and session-aware splits.
This cohort qualifies event timing and ERP classification only.
records.proof_posture: Good P300 pipeline qualification task; separate from language decoding.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Lower conceptual risk and MOABB support, but it answers P300 classification rather than task-matched typing.

records.license: GPL-3.0 as reported by the MOABB adapter; verify source-data terms before acquisition
records.task: Attend to one of four visual flicker frequencies for directional SSVEP classification.

sessions.detail: Each session has 100 labeled offline-training trials and 100 online-test trials; MOABB warns that SSVEP online-test labels are unavailable.

records.splits: Use labeled offline runs only unless source test labels and authorization are independently verified.

raw: MATLAB MAT through the MOABB adapter
formats.labels: Four frequency classes are available for offline-training trials.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One subject, both sessions, labeled offline runs only.

leakage_risks: Online-test runs in MOABB do not expose SSVEP labels.
Trial-wise splits can leak session and repeated stimulus structure.
EMG must be excluded or separately ablated.
known_limitations: SSVEP is visually evoked frequency classification, not speech or typing.
The 1 kHz source should not be downsampled before a frozen preprocessing protocol.
records.proof_posture: Good frequency-domain and replay qualification task; no language claim.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Useful to validate PSD and event timing, but not task-compatible with typed language.

records.task: Cue-based four-class motor imagery: left hand, right hand, both feet, or tongue.

sessions.detail: Six runs and 288 trials per session.

records.splits: Official train/evaluation sessions exist; preserve subject/session boundaries and source artifact flags.

acquisition.reference_scheme: Left mastoid reference; right mastoid ground

raw: MATLAB MAT through the MOABB adapter
formats.labels: Four motor-imagery classes and per-trial artifact information are available.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One subject across both sessions for a frozen cross-session qualification.

leakage_risks: Mixing runs or sessions before splitting overstates generalization.
Artifact flags must not be silently dropped.
Motor cues and timing cannot be compared with sentence targets.
known_limitations: Source signals are already bandpass and notch filtered.
The no-derivatives license requires care when redistributing transformed artifacts.

first_fresh_benchmark.rationale: Compact and well structured, but it does not exercise language or typing contracts.

records.dataset: Delineating neural contributions to EEG-based speech decoding
records.revision: OpenNeuro ds007591 v1.0.1 / NEMAR on007591 v1.0.0
records.task: Five color words under covert, minimally overt, and overt speech, including calibration and historical online sessions.

sessions.detail: The official mirror reports six sessions; the public analysis surface reports 21 recordings.

acquisition.geometry: Left-hemisphere high-density layout; exact BIDS coordinates require a separately authorized source lock.
acquisition.reference_unavailable_reason: Not frozen by this public-source refresh.

formats.labels: Five color words and speech condition.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: All three participants in the covert primary condition with recorded nuisance channels.

leakage_risks: EOG, oral EMG, microphone, display, and timing can carry class information.
Thousands of trials do not increase the population sample beyond three participants.
Historical online sessions do not establish a new live NeuroDecodeKit result.

The cohort cannot satisfy the registered minimum-ten full-control replication route.

records.revision: OpenNeuro ds007808 v1.0.0 / NEMAR on007808 v1.0.0
records.task: Longitudinal overt speech, listening, and covert speech across multiple EEG systems.

sessions.detail: Longitudinal recordings from three participants across multiple devices.

records.splits: Not eligible for the current participant-held-out replication route.

acquisition.geometry: Multiple source devices and layouts; exact per-file geometry requires metadata qualification.
acquisition.reference_unavailable_reason: Device-specific and not frozen by this refresh.

formats.labels: Speech, listening, covert events, and text or audio context, subject to exact source lock.

leakage_risks: Only three participants prevent population-level unseen-person inference.
Audio, EMG, cue, device, session, and longitudinal identity can dominate apparent decoding.
A chronological slice can leak neighboring recording context.

Open-vocabulary scale does not compensate for a three-person population sample.

records.task: Executed and imagined unilateral fist or bilateral fist/foot movement, plus eyes-open and eyes-closed baselines.

sessions.detail: Fourteen runs per subject: two one-minute baselines and twelve two-minute task runs.

records.splits: No default split; map T1/T2 by run type and freeze subject/run groups before fitting.

acquisition.reference_unavailable_reason: The canonical PhysioNet description does not state the acquisition reference.

formats.labels: T0 rest and context-dependent T1/T2 task onsets are available.

smallest_meaningful_slice.description: One two-minute task run plus its tiny event sidecar.

Baseline, execution, and imagery runs must remain distinct.
Random windows from the same subject/run leak recording context.

Approximate web file sizes are not an acquisition authorization.
